question: The New Development Bank is associated with which of the following international organisation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**BRICS**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• The **New Development Bank (NDB)** is an international financial institution established by the member countries of **BRICS**, which includes **Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa**.

• The bank was founded in **July 2014** during the 6th BRICS Summit held in **Fortaleza, Brazil**, and became operational in **2015**.

• The primary purpose of the NDB is to **mobilize resources for infrastructure and sustainable development projects** in emerging economies and developing countries.

• The bank aims to complement the existing efforts of multilateral and regional financial institutions, such as the World Bank and IMF, in addressing development challenges.

• The headquarters of the New Development Bank is located in **Shanghai, China**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Key Features of BRICS:**

• **BRICS** is an acronym for the grouping of the world's major emerging economies: **Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa**.

• It was originally known as **BRIC** before the inclusion of **South Africa** in 2010.

• The group represents about **42% of the world's population**, **23% of global GDP**, and **16% of world trade**.

• **Functions of the New Development Bank:**

• The NDB provides financial assistance for **infrastructure development** and **sustainable development projects** in BRICS and other emerging economies.

• It offers financial products like **loans, equity participation, guarantees, and technical assistance**.

• The bank promotes the use of local currencies in its operations to reduce dependency on major global currencies like the US Dollar.

• **Governance Structure of NDB:**

• The NDB is governed by a **Board of Governors** and a **Board of Directors** comprising representatives from the member countries.

• The first President of the NDB was **K. V. Kamath** from India.

• The presidency of the bank rotates every five years among the member countries.

• **Comparison with Other Institutions:**

• Unlike the **World Bank** and **IMF**, which have been criticized for their Western-centric governance structures, the NDB aims to give equal voting rights to all its members.

• The NDB focuses specifically on infrastructure and sustainable development in emerging economies, differentiating it from global financial institutions that have a broader scope.
